response.floor_summary: Floor 4 is the topmost residential floor of the 2 BHK apartment, featuring a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom, a study/home office, open-plan living-dining-kitchen, utility area, two balconies, an internal corridor, and an exclusive private terrace befitting the top-floor position.
